heroSub: At Phinia's facility in the Izmir ESBAS Free Zone, loading and coating operations were made fully traceable on a bar/rack and batch basis.
contextTitle: Bar/rack and batch visibility in coating operations
contextP1: Phinia's manufacturing facility in the Izmir ESBAS Free Zone serves the automotive industry.
contextP2: Within this project at the coating plant, loading and coating operations were digitized and managed through bar/rack and batch relationships.
problemTitle: Reliable control of loading rules and recipe compliance
problemLede: The plant needed a reliable way to manage which product was loaded onto which bar/rack, which bar/rack belonged to which batch, and applicable loading constraints. Manual handling introduced risks of incorrect loading, recipe mismatch, and traceability gaps.

problemList.text: Manual tracking of bar/rack-product-batch relationships was error-prone.
Product group, min/max loading limits, and recipe conditions had to be enforced consistently in operations.

solutionTitle: PLC-integrated bar/rack and batch traceability over OPC-UA
solutionLede: Direct communication with the PLC was established via OPC-UA. Bar/rack data captured at the loading station was matched with real-time batch data, bar/rack IDs were retained on batch records, and authorized loading conditions were managed through a central panel.

steps.title: Bar/Rack and Batch Matching
steps.text: Bar/rack data read at loading is matched with live batch information in the predefined format.

steps.title: Rules and Recipe Setup
steps.text: Bar/rack-product mappings, product groups, min/max limits, and PLC recipe relations are configured in the panel.

steps.title: Conditional Loading
steps.text: Loading at coating entry is validated against approved rules and product quantity is sent to PLC for surface-area calculations.

steps.title: Exit Result Tracking
steps.text: At coating exit, bar/rack and batch records are linked with result data and stored.

techTitle: C# SCADA, OPC-UA, barcode scanners, and PLC infrastructure

techGrid.title: C# SCADA Application
techGrid.text: Manages bar/rack-batch matching, rule validation, data flow, and traceability records.

techGrid.title: OPC-UA Protocol
techGrid.text: Provides reliable real-time data exchange between SCADA and PLC.

techGrid.title: PLC and Recipe Control
techGrid.text: Controls shop-floor workflows, recipe mapping, and loading validation.

techGrid.title: Barcode Scanners
techGrid.text: Read bar/rack and product identifiers to initiate validated operations.

techGrid.title: Administration Panel
techGrid.text: Centralizes bar/rack-product mapping, product groups, loading limits, and recipe definitions.

integrationTitle: End-to-end data flow with OPC-UA and Oracle
integrationDesc: The system integrates with the shop-floor PLC over OPC-UA and with Oracle on the enterprise side. Bar/rack, batch, recipe, and loading data are acquired through OPC-UA, while traceability and result data are shared centrally in Oracle.

integrationList.text: Bar/rack, batch, recipe, and loading data are collected from the line in real time.
Traceability and process result data are shared and reported in the enterprise layer.

resultsTitle: Reliable process governance and full traceability

resultsGrid.title: Bar/Rack and Batch Traceability
resultsGrid.text: Loading and coating processes became fully traceable at bar/rack and batch level.

resultsGrid.title: Rule-Based Loading
resultsGrid.text: Only approved loading operations were allowed using product group checks and min/max limits.

resultsGrid.title: Higher Process Reliability
resultsGrid.text: PLC recipe mapping and direct OPC-UA communication reduced operational mismatch risks.
